summary: Frontend-only validation of the Privacy Choices & Data Deletion correction on DRUNK PIGEONS. All 10 acceptance items verified on the preview URL (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). (1) The old Support ID panel is fully removed — testIDs support-id-value, copy-support-id, email-delete-request, manage-ad-choices and manage-ad-choices-msg are ABSENT from the DOM, and the strings 'Support ID' and 'include your Support ID' do not appear on the screen. (2) The minimal-info note (privacy-minimal-note) is rendered near the top with the exact copy about no identity documents / real names / emails / phone numbers / passwords / precise location. (3) NO-DATA case (fresh localStorage): delete-leaderboard-data button is not rendered, google-ump-button is not rendered, no horizontal scroll and no visible empty gap — the 'Advertising choices' and 'Delete leaderboard data' subheadings flow into their following prose immediately. (4) HAS-DATA case (seeded dp_playerId=pdel7e6a3b5baebdfe55 + nickname ScreenBird4738 registered via /api/leaderboard/register): the DELETE MY LEADERBOARD DATA button appears; tapping it opens delete-confirm-modal with the expected copy ('This removes your public nickname and leaderboard score from our servers. Your purchases are not affected. This can't be undone.') plus delete-cancel and delete-confirm buttons. Cancel dismisses the modal and leaves the button intact. Confirm removes the server record: delete-success replaces the button, GET /api/leaderboard/me?playerId=... returns nickname:null, GET /api/leaderboard/check?nickname=ScreenBird4738 returns available:true, and local dp_nickname is cleared to ''. No email/name/Support ID is ever requested. (5) Google UMP button is NOT shown on the web preview (Ads.getPrivacyOptionsRequired resolves to false) and no empty gap under 'Advertising choices'. (6) Responsiveness verified across 360x740, 360x800, 384x854, 412x915, 375x667, 390x844, 393x852, 430x932 — no horizontal scroll on any width, minimal note wraps correctly. (7) Regression: Legal & Privacy list still shows exactly 6 public docs (privacy, terms, purchases, leaderboard-rules, privacy-choices, online-safety); every doc opens with title + Last updated line rendered. No internal-only doc leaks in the list.
critical_code_review_comments: LegalDocumentViewer.js injectAfter matches subheading text case-insensitively via regex on 'advertising choices' / 'delete leaderboard data'. If the legalDocuments.js copy for those subheadings is ever localized or renamed, the injected UI (google-ump-button, delete-leaderboard-data, delete-success) will silently disappear. Consider keying injection by a stable section id/testID rather than by heading text.

In doDelete(), local state (nickname, submittedBest, submittedBestSilly) is cleared only on server success. If the server returns ok:false the local state is preserved which is correct — but there is no retry affordance beyond re-tapping the (now-hidden after success) button; the delete-fail message is shown but the DELETE button remains visible via pcHasData=true which is fine. No action needed, just noting the flow is intentional.

Ads.getPrivacyOptionsRequired() is called on every open of the Privacy Choices doc; on web it resolves synchronously to false which is fine, but there is no error boundary — if a future native implementation throws, pcUmp will stay false (safe default). Consider wrapping in try/catch inside the promise chain for defensive coding.
test_credentials: None. HAS-DATA flow seeded via POST /api/leaderboard/register {playerId:'pdel7e6a3b5baebdfe55', nickname:'ScreenBird4738'} then localStorage dp_playerId+dp_nickname set to that pair before reload.
seed_data_creation: Registered one leaderboard record (playerId=pdel7e6a3b5baebdfe55, nickname=ScreenBird4738) to exercise the HAS-DATA delete flow. That record was deleted by the tested UI flow; server GET /me returns nickname:null and /check returns available:true afterwards — no residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To seed HAS-DATA state for Privacy Choices delete: (1) POST {EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL}/api/leaderboard/register with a fresh playerId (prefix 'pdel' + hex) and a fresh nickname; (2) evaluate localStorage.setItem('dp_playerId', pid) + localStorage.setItem('dp_nickname', nick); (3) page.reload; (4) open legal-privacy-button -> legal-doc-row-privacy-choices; wait ~2s for LeaderboardAPI.me() before asserting delete-leaderboard-data. To test NO-DATA: localStorage.clear() before reload. Google UMP button intentionally hidden on web preview — do not treat its absence as a bug. Delete button visibility is text-keyed to the 'Delete leaderboard data' subheading in legalDocuments.js — if that heading is renamed the button will vanish.
rca of the issue: No issue. Correction task fully verified: Support ID card gone, minimal note present, direct delete flow works end-to-end (modal + cancel + confirm + server deletion + local clear + nickname freed), google-ump-button correctly hidden on web with no empty gap, and no regressions in the six-doc legal area.
